description: A DISTINCT RETURN may order by a field it projects.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.city AS city ORDER BY p.city ASC

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.city AS city ORDER BY p.city ASC $$) AS (city agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN DISTINCT p.city AS city ORDER BY p.city ASC

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.city AS city)) ORDER BY city ASC

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT DISTINCT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.city AS city)) ORDER BY city ASC
